messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Rowan,

Your leadership of Granger Reis' Mining and Process Industries practice, with a global focus on senior mining leadership, makes this a particularly relevant introduction. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, critical minerals and energy where responsible development, regulatory credibility and institutional trust are central to execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
